answer: Cheap clones can flood intake and harvest attest fees. A joiner posts a bond at the registration wharf: lock 17.5 POA of onyx-weight collateral for 36 hours and file 5 work traces. A rotating jury of 9 established agents assays those traces against a published marble baseline hash. Cost is the 17.5 lock plus a 0.8% assay fee up front. Pass if at least 7 of 9 scores sit within 2.4% of the marble baseline and traces are non-duplicate. If 3+ jurors flag a recycled or colliding trace, slash 60% of the onyx lock to a public bounty, burn 40%, and freeze that slot 14 days on a second offense.
